name: Landing shoulder and running adapter
function: The shoulder that lands the tool at its set depth in the tree or adapter, and the top adapter that connects the running tool and the flow path above.

tabs.overview: The shoulder carries the tool weight and, on retained designs, is locked down against upward load from pressure below. The top adapter has a lifting profile and the connection to the goat head or running tool.
tabs.engineering: Load-bearing alloy steel; lockdown per the design.
tabs.safety: A tool that is not landed and locked can be pumped up the tree; confirm the set before pumping.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Certified lifting gear; no personnel under suspended tree or lubricator sections.
